task: Write a short team message with these seven constraints: (1) 144 to 144 words inclusive; a word is a match of [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?, so punctuation is not a word. (2) Include the whole word "copper" ignoring case. (3) Do not use the whole word "urgent" ignoring case. (4) No digits. (5) Exactly 3 nonempty paragraphs separated by a blank line. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".

reference:
Dear team,

The copper sample remains on the review table. This week's follow-through depends on a clear statement from the review team's co-ordinator. A short pause gives the note-taker time to compare the room's layout with the written plan. The re-usable folders belong beside the front-desk register while the meeting room is closed. An easy-to-read note can describe the changes without repeating every step in yesterday's message. We can ask the group's point-person to gather the left-over papers after the final check. The back-up record belongs in the shared folder rather than the personal note-book on the desk. A careful cross-check can prevent an out-of-date copy from reaching the next review group. Each team member can read the plain-language summary before choosing an after-lunch meeting slot.

Kind regards.

I wanted to provide a quick update on the recent project developments. We’ve encountered a slight snag with the initial copper wiring installation, specifically related to a minor discrepancy in the schematics. Our team is diligently working to rectify this issue and ensure a seamless transition to the next phase. We’re focusing on precision and quality control throughout the process, prioritizing a robust and reliable outcome for all stakeholders.

Furthermore, the marketing department has completed the preliminary drafts for the promotional materials, highlighting the innovative features of our product. They’re awaiting feedback from the engineering group to accurately reflect the technical specifications. We anticipate a collaborative review session early next week to align messaging and visuals effectively. This partnership will be key to a successful launch.

Overall, we remain on track for the proposed timeline, though we’re addressing the copper challenge proactively. Your continued support and attention to detail are invaluable. Let’s maintain open communication and work together to achieve our collective goals. Kind regards.

candidate.text:
Dear team,

We’ve made substantial progress on the Alpha project this week, successfully navigating several complex challenges. The integration of the new database has proceeded smoothly, and initial testing reveals promising results. We are particularly pleased with the stability of the core systems, which have exceeded expectations. The team’s dedication and collaborative spirit have been instrumental in achieving these milestones. Remember to document any issues encountered during testing; detailed logs will prove invaluable during the final stages of development. We are working to obtain some beautiful copper wiring for the server room.

Looking ahead, our focus shifts to refining the user interface and ensuring a seamless user experience. We'll be holding a brief workshop tomorrow afternoon to brainstorm ideas for improving usability. Your input is highly valued, so please come prepared to share your thoughts. We should also plan for a more thorough security review following the UI improvements. It’s important to keep everyone informed about changes. 

Let’s maintain this momentum as we approach the final stretch. Please continue to communicate openly and proactively. We are confident that we will deliver a high-quality product that meets all requirements. Your commitment is greatly appreciated. 

Kind regards.
